meta.title: Sum Total reduced by a Fixed Value
gaps: Apply a fixed-value reduction of ₹204.34 in the vendor's cost-breakdown bid control, click Revise Bid, and verify that the new current bid equals the original Sum Total minus ₹204.34.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Apply a fixed-value reduction of ₹204.34 in the vendor's cost-breakdown bid control, click Revise Bid, and verify that the new current bid equals the original Sum Total minus ₹204.34.

steps.note: Open the prepared live-auction vendor session.
Open the auction's vendor pricing screen.
Confirm the vendor screen exposes the Fixed Value mode named in the case.

args.need: Use the vendor cost-breakdown screen to keep Fixed Value selected, enter a ₹204.34 reduction, click Revise Bid, and verify the current bid equals the original Sum Total minus ₹204.34.

steps.note: No catalog step can perform or assert this vendor-side fixed-value revision.
Confirm the vendor screen shows a submitted bid after the tester's revision.
